CROSS-REFERENCE.

SUBJECT: GROEHL.

15.12.38. In an intercepted letter from Karl GROEHL (Post Mark Paris) to Karl OTTEN, London, dated 15.12.38, was enclosed an article regarding German aviation. This article was sent to S.I.S. on 9.1.39, no copy being kept in this office.

Original in PF.45807 OTTEN, 108d. v.2,114a....dated...as above........
D.G.
10.1.39.

S. Form 81.
